correctness.rationale: Conformal pre/post normalization reduces the map to \(G_c(w)=1/w-c\log|w|\). The exact derivatives give \(J=|w|^{-4}(1+\operatorname{Re}(cw))\) and \(|\mu|=|c||w|/[2|1+(c/2)w|]\), whose essential supremum is \(|c|/(2-|c|)\). The circle images have centers \(-c\log r\) and radii \(1/r\); the inequality \(|c|\log(r_2/r_1)<1/r_1-1/r_2\) for \(|c|<1\) proves strict nesting and global univalence. The reciprocal exterior extension attains exactly the internal Beltrami norm, so the threshold is both necessary and sufficient.
